description: This script provides functions for managing NAND flash memory, UBI volumes, and upgrade procedures in an OpenWrt environment. It handles detection, mounting, formatting, volume management, and firmware upgrade procedures for NAND-based devices.

methods.name: ubi_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node for a UBI volume based on its device directory.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds the UBI volume based on its name and associated UBI device.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Finds the UBI device associated with a given MTD partition.

methods.name: nand_get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads and returns the magic number from a NAND device using dd and hexdump.

methods.name: get_magic_long_tar
methods.description: Extracts and reads the magic number from a tar archive.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the magic number/type of a NAND device or image.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the format of a tar archive or contained image.

methods.name: identify_if_gzip
methods.description: Checks if a file is gzip compressed; if so, returns 'z'.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from an image to a mounted UBI volume.

methods.name: nand_remove_ubiblock
methods.description: Removes a UBI block device, unmounting if necessary.

methods.name: nand_attach_ubi
methods.description: Attaches a UBI device to a partition, formatting and creating volumes if needed.

methods.name: nand_detach_ubi
methods.description: Detaches a UBI device from its partition, removing associated block devices.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI volumes for upgrade by creating/removing volumes and setting sizes.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Writes a ubinized image to the UBI partition.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Writes a UBIFS image to a UBI root volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Writes a FIT image to a UBI kernel volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Processes a TAR archive to upgrade partitions and volumes.

methods.name: nand_verify_if_gzip_file
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a gzip compressed file.

methods.name: nand_verify_tar_file
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a tar archive.

methods.name: nand_do_flash_file
methods.description: Determines file type and executes the appropriate upgrade method.

methods.name: nand_do_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from a predefined path.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade routine that flashes a provided file.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Finalizes a successful upgrade, restoring configs and rebooting.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_failed
methods.description: Handles failure of upgrade, logging and rebooting.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if a file is suitable for upgrade based on its format and control file.
